svg.title: What changes between LAN and tunnel access?
svg.desc: Both routes reach the same restricted remote server. LAN uses plain HTTP/WebSocket; tunnel mode adds an external HTTPS endpoint and a local tunnel process.
svg.text: What changes between LAN and tunnel access?
Remote access · request routes; responses return along the same route

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
Arrow: read its label in the arrow direction. Cylinder: stored data. Diamond: a check.
